_meta.note: G7 SUPPLY8 (G7_REFERENCE 13.9c-48): the magazine / ammo + fuel bay card and its AIRDROP RETRIEVAL OP. One drop at a time with a cooldown: an airdrop pod lands in open ground 4-6 tiles outside the facility gate; two seven-man Sentinel GO teams move out first and take up defensive positions around it; four Facility Engineers follow with the tracked drone cargo carrier (fast, hardened, small ray shield), load the pod and bring it home; the stock is added at the magazine and the carrier parks in its small garage beside the magazine. Every number PROVISIONAL.

g8_cargo_carrier.name: Tracked Cargo Carrier
g8_cargo_carrier._role: unmanned tracked drone cargo bed of the facility engineers (13.9c-48): quick, hardened hull, small ray shield (rules.g8_supply.shield). PROVISIONAL.

g8_b_cargo_carrier.name: Tracked Cargo Carrier
g8_b_cargo_carrier._role: Human B copy of g8_cargo_carrier. PROVISIONAL.

g8_supply_pod.name: Airdrop Supply Pod
g8_supply_pod._role: the delivered pallet pod (13.9c-48): stands where it landed until the engineers load it; destroyed = the drop is lost (retry free after the cooldown). PROVISIONAL.

cn_carrier_garage.name: Carrier Garage
cn_carrier_garage._note: SUPPLY8 (13.9c-48): small armoured garage of the tracked cargo carrier beside the magazine (placed by Supply8 off every lane, zone, door and the approach, door onto a lane). PROVISIONAL.
